whyChooseTitle:
Safety is not a tagline.
It is accountability.
whyChooseDesc: At TripNaari, we believe solo travel should bring freedom, not fear. We listened to real feedback from our traveler community, kept the safety standards everyone loves, and fixed every operational friction point. Today, every journey is backed by written safety SOPs, verified local partners, and clear escalation timelines—so you can explore the world with complete confidence.

whyChooseReasons.title: Trusted Vendors & Safety-Audited Stays
whyChooseReasons.desc: Every hotel, homestay, and cab partner is thoroughly vetted for security, hygiene, and safe locations. All drivers are police-verified, fully insured, and possess a minimum of 5 years of hill-driving experience for mountain routes.

whyChooseReasons.title: Ready Emergency Resources & On-Ground Contacts
whyChooseReasons.desc: You never have to look for help. Every departure includes a complete emergency kit with direct contacts for local police stations, nearby hospitals, ambulance services, and verified local ground support networks.

whyChooseReasons.title: . Always-Present Expert Trip Leaders
whyChooseReasons.desc: Your Trip Leader stays in the same accommodation, travels in your vehicle, conducts daily morning safety briefings, and carries CPR and first-aid kits (with oxygen support on Himalayan routes)

whyChooseReasons.title: Guaranteed Pre-Trip Clarity
whyChooseReasons.desc: No last-minute confusion. Exactly 7 days before travel, you receive complete hotel categories, itineraries, pickup points, emergency contacts, and entry into your private group WhatsApp network.

whyChooseReasons.title: Tier Support & Direct Founder Access
whyChooseReasons.desc: Issues get resolved in minutes through a clear hierarchy: Level 1 on-ground Trip Leader resolution, Level 2 24/7 Operations team escalation, and Level 3 direct Founder escalation within 24 hours.

whyChooseReasons.title: Radical Policy Transparency & Accountability
whyChooseReasons.desc: Every touchpoint follows strict written timelines—including guaranteed 7–10 day refund processing and a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, unsafe conduct, or hidden fees.
